## Summary

- Remove the legacy standalone folder-create button from Overview.
- Add a `New folder` action to the global + menu.
- Show the Community Plus CTA for unregistered self-hosted users.
- Create folders in the current project, or in Personal when no project is selected.
- Refresh the current project after creating a folder.
- Remove unused translation keys.

### The bug

A button to create folders was shown to unregistered users, but disappeared right after they upgraded to Registered community.
The button in question:
<img width="500" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c286f676-6eff-41f3-8aaf-4d464a90501c" />
After the upgrade it was hard to find how to create folders, because it was available only under project context menu (not in Overview either):
<img height="262" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7421f659-e684-4de5-944a-4b4ab2ffa1ea" />

This PR adds a global "New folder" action:
<img height="362" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6dfc6237-e788-4acf-b950-3227c8f9b928" />

For unregistered users we still show the CTA modal:
<img height="500" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d284efae-b37d-4fdd-9729-57d109699128" />

<!--
Describe what the PR does.
Photos and videos are recommended.
-->

## How to test

- Open a totally fresh instance
- See that you now have a global action "New folder" instead of the old folder icon
- Check that once you click on it, a CTA modal is clicked.
- Once you upgrade, the folder action starts creating a folder in a project you're currently in or in the Personal project for all other cases (incl. when being on the Overview page)

## Related Linear tickets, Github issues, and Community forum posts

Closes https://linear.app/n8n/issue/KNO-17/community-issue-registered-community-edition-folder-creation-button
Closes https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues/38862
